decision_conditions: Condition : 0 - The use hereby permitted for motorcycle workshop purposes shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - 3.	The carrying out of repairs, maintenance or other works to any motorbike, or the storage of motorbikes or of parts, shall not take place outside of the building, unless otherwise approved.

Condition : 4 - 4.	The hours of operation of the motorbike workshop shall be 9.00am to 6.00pm Monday to Friday and 9.00am to 5.30pm Saturday, with no work to be undertaken on Sunday or public holidays.
Condition : 5 - 5.	The use of the building hereby permitted shall be used only as a motorbike workshop ancillary to the retail use of the premises and for no other purpose.
Condition : 6 - 6.	No additional doors or windows shall be formed in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - 7.	There shall be no more than 6 motorbike spaces on the site at the rear.
Condition : 8 - 8.	The parking of motorbikes shall not restrict access to the rear of properties at Nos. 533 and 535 Staines Road.
description: Change of use of rear building from storage to motorbike workshop.
